persona: HR operations executive who already runs payroll at a mid-size firm
resumeText:
Rahul Verma | Noida | rahul.verma@example.com

EXPERIENCE
HR Operations Executive - Payroll, Yamuna Facility Services, Noida (2022 - present)
- Processed monthly payroll for 850 employees across three states.
- Uploaded the monthly PF ECR and paid ESIC contributions before the due dates.
- Deducted professional tax as per state slabs and filed the returns.
- Maintained wage registers under the Minimum Wages Act and Payment of Bonus Act.
- Calculated full and final settlements for exiting employees, including gratuity and leave encashment.
- Ran payroll on greytHR and reconciled salary variances in Excel every month.

HR Assistant, Aravali Security Services, Noida (2021 - 2022)
- Collected attendance and leave data from site supervisors for payroll.

SKILLS
TDS on salary, Excel, greytHR, PF and ESI

EDUCATION
BCom, Delhi University, 2021
